notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hello "Chat with Yu" players!

I want to thank everyone for the support and enthusiasm in our game. We have made some updates to improve your experience, including text corrections, new effects and sounds to make the game more fun, and bug fixes.

Thank you for playing "Chat with Yu" and we hope you enjoy the updates.

Best regards,
"Chat with Yu" team.

tags.feature: new effects and sounds to make the game more fun

notes.title: Ultrawide Update
notes.content:
First, we wanted to thank you for the feedback. It is very important for us to improve our processes and games.

In response to requests, we've added support for ultrawide monitors. As well as making some small changes and fixing bugs. If you need support with anything, you can get in touch via [url=https://twitter.com/FaphoodGames]Twitter[/url] or email to support@faphood.com

Sincerely Yu
